title: Spyglass: Officially Launched and Ready for You
summary: We're thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, now providing a robust and refined experience for all users.

title: Enhanced File Control in Editor
summary: Gain complete control over your creative space with new features that let you easily manage, upload, and customize the display of your files directly within the editor.

title: Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: We've launched a new public roadmap page, empowering you to easily track our progress and discover what exciting features are coming next.

title: Enhanced Interactive Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a more responsive and visually appealing way to manage your tasks with our newly redesigned checkboxes, now bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable for a seamless experience.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Experience seamless teamwork with upgraded collaboration features designed to bring greater clarity and effortlessness to working together.

title: Unlocking Collaborative Discoveries
summary: Experience enhanced collaboration as you effortlessly discover and engage with all shared items, bringing your collective ideas to life with unprecedented ease.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source
summary: We are thrilled to announce that Noeko is now open source, empowering our community with greater control and transparency over its development and future.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Get ready for a truly global Noeko experience as we introduce comprehensive support for diverse international languages.

title: Elevated Aesthetics: New & Improved Themes
summary: Get ready for a vibrant refresh as we meticulously refine existing themes and roll out an exciting array of new, stylish options to personalize your workspace.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map Filters
summary: Transform your personal knowledge map into a powerful workflow starter by easily filtering content and visualizing shared items with friends.

title: Advanced Search and Custom Collections
summary: Discover and organize your information more efficiently with powerful new search filters and the ability to save customized collections of your most relevant documents.

title: Dynamic Note Connections
summary: Experience a more intuitive and flexible way to organize your thoughts with new display options and enhanced interactivity for your linked notes.

title: Introducing Noeko: Flexible Hosting and Advanced Plans
summary: Prepare for the official launch of Noeko, bringing you the power to choose between self-hosting for complete control or leveraging our convenient cloud-hosted plans with enhanced features.

title: Personalized Greetings for Every Moment
summary: Enjoy a more personalized experience with greetings that accurately reflect the time of day, ensuring a warm and accurate welcome whenever you log in.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Efficiently manage your content by directly removing items from tags, deleting entries, or instantly viewing details for ideas, quests, and sources, all from within any tag's list.

title: Unlock More Content Types for Deeper Insights
summary: Effortlessly bring all your essential knowledge into one place by integrating diverse content formats like YouTube videos, websites, and text files directly into your workspace.
